scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to $(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin master && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin master && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin master && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
